    The meter must obey P = V × I × PF. When the reported power disagrees with that product by more than 5%, the packet is quarantined and a state-estimated value (smoothed history of clean readings) takes its place.

    A stealthy attacker falsifies V, I and P together, so the local physics check passes. Energy conservation still fails: the transformer supply must equal the sum of pole loads plus line loss, and the total must fit the load baseline for the current hour and temperature.

    Gate 1 accepts a packet only when its timestamp is within ±5 s of server time, its nonce has never been seen, and the sender stays under 6 packets per second. Anything else is dropped before it reaches the physics layers.

    When DoS cuts the uplink, the ESP32 keeps recording. Each block stores Hashn = SHA256(Datan + Hashn−1), computed with the browser Web Crypto API. After reconnection, the chain is recomputed block by block; any edited record breaks its own hash.
